body:
## What changed

`apply_tiered_discount` now requires an order to have **more than 10** items
before the 20% discount tier applies. Previously `quantity == 10` already
qualified for 20% off, which felt too generous for an order that's exactly
at the threshold rather than clearly over it.

## Why

Product asked for the 20% tier to kick in only once an order is *strictly
larger* than the 10-item mark, matching how the 5-item tier already reads
("5 or more" felt fine there, but 10 should be a harder line).

## Testing

- Updated `test_twenty_percent_at_upper_boundary_ten` to assert the new
  90.0 result at quantity = 10.
- `pytest tests/ -v` — all 9 tests pass.

Scope: `project-6-doorbell-loop/` only.
title: Tighten upper discount boundary (quantity > 10 for 20% tier)
